title: Quintessential Festive British Jam Scones Clotted Cream
description: Rich and shaggy British dish featuring jam and clotted cream, perfect for a festive treat, this recipe is a low-fat friendly version of the classic cornish dessert.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, combine the sifted flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the cubed butter to the dry ingredients and rub until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the low fat milk and beaten egg.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until the dough comes together.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead a few times until it becomes smooth.
Pat the dough into a circle that is about 2.5cm thick.
Use a biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass to cut out scones.
Place the scones on a baking tray lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1cm of space between each scone.
Bake the scones in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
While the scones are baking, prepare the jam and clotted cream for serving.
Once the scones are done, remove them from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes on a wire rack.
